value.about:
XStory.app puts a lot of emphasis on video creation, offering several ways to turn prompts and images into personalised adult content. Alongside its library of more than 1,000 templates, it has tools for building multi-scene videos, controlling character poses and creating short stories involving multiple characters.

The Pose and Micro Drama features are particularly interesting. Rather than simply generating a short clip, they give users more control over the action, characters and overall scene. The prompt-based tools also make it possible to create something more tailored than the usual collection of preset animations.

Video generation is where XStory makes its strongest impression. There is still room for variation in what AI can produce, but the range of creative options gives it more depth than a basic image generator. New users can also try it with free signup credits.

Key features

AI-generated adult video and image content

More than 1,000 adult templates

Custom video creation using prompts and images

Pose and multi-character story modes

Free credits for new users
